title: i18n(plugin-audit): ship the audit objects and activity sentences in all eleven platform languages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBxjikPH2bUin9o95gbAxsx)_


domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU

Refs #30512 — package 4 of 11 (`@objectstack/plugin-audit`). The card stays open: the last PR of the series flips the bundle check to the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 审计、动态、评论四个对象（`sys_audit_log`、`sys_activity`、`sys_comment`、`sys_comment_reaction`）的名称、字段、选项、帮助和视图名，以及动态流的句子（「创建了…」「更新了…」「…提到了你」），补上繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡、俄语、德语、韩语 7 种，与平台语言表的 11 种一致。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表（#29428 裁决 F）要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 4 个包（对象 128 条 + 句子 8 条）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。改了一条测试：它原来用 `fr-FR` 当「没有语言包」的例子，现在法语包已有，**是测试的前提变了、不是放宽断言**——「没有语言包时保留原句」改用 `it-IT` 验证，另加一条钉住 `fr-FR` 读到 `fr` 包。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前）、`messages.ts`，再看 `activity-summary-reader-locale.integration.test.ts` 的那处改动。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=audit` 输出 `plugins/plugin-audit in sync`；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Seven new locales for the audit package under the platform locale table's tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 128 object leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` and served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing three. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- `messages.ts` gains the seven locales' activity-feed sentences (8 ids each, the same `{{holes}}` as `en`), registered as each locale's `messages`.
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the seven tags and its merge baseline imports the seven bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## The one test change — the premise moved, the assertion did not loosen

`activity-summary-reader-locale.integration.test.ts` used `fr-FR` as its example of a reader locale with no pack ("a reader locale with no template keeps the stored sentence"). Once `fr` ships, `fr-FR` resolves to it, so that premise is no longer true of French. The no-pack case now uses `it-IT` (Italian is not a platform-table language) and still asserts the stored English sentence byte for byte; a new case pins that `fr-FR` reads the `fr` pack (`A créé Contract « NDA »`). Nothing is asserted less strictly than before.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en`. Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers left in Latin script. `t()` has no plural selection, so the `ru`/`ar` "{{count}} more" sentence uses a counting form that reads correctly for every number.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** `URL` in every locale; beyond that native words only: `fr` `Action`, `Emoji`, `Import`, `Mentions`, `Type`; `pt-BR` `Emoji`; `de` `Emoji`, `Import`, `Thread`. The extractor records each as a source copy. `pt-BR` writes sign-in/sign-out as `Acesso` / `Encerramento de sessão` rather than the English loanwords.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
